text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D21","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 8 H7 THRU` "},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"IZBP"}],"comment":"Dimension D21 specifies an ⌀8 H7 fit on a part that receives IZBP plating (per the surface_treatment field), but no allowance is made for the plating thickness.
